net_current_contract_notes: The cable basis is three 12V pins at approximately 13 A per pin.
The service USB path is bounded by its 750 mA hold current from connector through fuse and ferrite.

User-approved routing requirement on 2026-10-24: /VCC_J1 and VCC_RJ45 each carry 1 A continuously with the existing 1.25 geometry margin and no input-sharing credit. This is explicit conductor authority, not an inferred upstream rating from the +5VSB mux output and not borrowed from another board.

Canonical chain: J1 pin 1 -> /VCC_J1 -> FB2 pin 1; FB2 pin 2 -> VCC_RJ45 -> TPS2121 U4 IN1 pin 7, C45 pin 1 and the R15/R17 divider upper legs. The requirement changes no part, pinout or claimed load and does not qualify the generic 0R link, connector contacts, via plating/barrels, inrush, capacitor leakage, fault current, thermal behavior or fabrication release.
